unresolved.reason: The selected carrier binds the x86_64 wheel, six AMD64 runnable rows and an acceptance receipt over AMD64 review seats. Copying any of them would assert untested ARM64 model runability and acceptance.
unresolved.required: Qualify each model provider on ARM64, generate an ARM64 carrier with arm64 runnable rows only where proven, bind new exact-source review seats and receipt, and preserve first-use consent.

unresolved.reason: The selected closure and setup helper are AMD64-only and the helper refuses other architectures. No ARM64 closure file exists, and the candidate images below have not been downloaded or verified.
unresolved.required: Retain exact ARM64 package bytes at release-controlled URLs, verify both Android images byte-for-byte, add an architecture-selected closure and helper path with its own checksum binding, then pass Android runtime acceptance on a Binder-capable ARM64 kernel.

android.image_selection: Same official OTA channels and LineageOS 20 VANILLA/MAINLINE flavour as the AMD64 closure, whose two image ids are present in the x86_64 channels. The ARM64 channel has no 20260428 vendor build, so the candidate pairs the 20260403 system and vendor builds.
android.package_authority: The four Waydroid packages are the AMD64 closure versions. Their arm64 records come from the signed Waydroid trixie index; the waydroid bytes are the already retained architecture-independent asset. Upstream has replaced same-version AMD64 bytes before, so the three arm64 upstream URLs must be retained at release-controlled URLs before selection.

binder.debian_arm64_kernel: linux 6.12.113-1 (kernel-team commit 190dd0f622d2e556aa9a85223834e0d24ec3a650): CONFIG_ANDROID_BINDER_IPC=m in debian/config/arm64/config; binderfs is not set, as on AMD64
binder.kernel_requirements: 4K pages and CONFIG_COMPAT=y are set in the Debian arm64 configuration; vendor kernels must be checked separately
